hero.title: Empyrean Beauty
hero.subtitle: Salon and Barber Studio
hero.intro: Meaning “heaven-like.” Seventeen years of craft, sustainable product, and the most elevated chair in Montgomery County.

intro.heading: 17+ Years of Experience
intro.body: Empyrean Beauty is a Salon & Barber Studio in New Caney, TX consisting of salon stylists and a barber. With over 17 years of experience and certifications, combined with an array of additional convenient services, we guarantee you the most elevated experience in the area.

booking.heading: Book your visit today.
booking.body: We do take walk-in appointments, but prefer booking with our online calendar. We can't wait to see you!

testimonials.quote: Thank you so much for going out of your way and helping me get this color. It is like a treasure in these difficult times.
testimonials.author: Sonia T.
